title: Credential theft through phishing
cause: Staff receive convincing phishing emails and multi-factor authentication is not enforced on all remote access
event: An attacker uses stolen credentials to access internal systems
consequence: Data exposure, fraud, operational disruption and regulatory notification costs

title: Failure of a critical single-source supplier
cause: Key goods or services are sourced from one supplier with no tested alternative
event: The supplier stops delivering due to insolvency, disruption or dispute
consequence: Service interruption, emergency procurement at premium prices and lost revenue

title: Loss of key personnel
cause: Critical knowledge sits with a few individuals without succession plans
event: A key person resigns or is unavailable at short notice
consequence: Delays to critical work, loss of relationships and knowledge

title: Payment fraud through supplier bank-detail changes
cause: Supplier bank details can be changed on email instruction without independent call-back
event: A fraudster impersonates a supplier and redirects payments
consequence: Direct financial loss that is rarely recoverable
controls: Dual approval for payments over threshold

title: Failure to implement new regulatory requirements on time
cause: Regulatory change is tracked informally by individual teams
event: A new requirement takes effect before processes are updated
consequence: Fines, enforcement action and remediation cost

title: Mishandling of personal data
cause: Personal data is held in many systems without a complete data inventory
event: Personal data is disclosed, retained too long or used without a lawful basis
consequence: Regulatory penalties, complaints and loss of customer trust

title: Prolonged outage of core business systems
cause: Ageing infrastructure with a single data centre and untested failover
event: Core systems are unavailable for more than 24 hours
consequence: Inability to trade or serve customers, revenue loss and reputational damage

title: Ransomware attack
cause: Unpatched systems and flat network architecture
event: Ransomware encrypts operational systems and backups connected to the network
consequence: Extended outage, extortion demand, data loss and recovery costs

title: Negative media or social media escalation
cause: Service failures and complaints are handled slowly and inconsistently
event: A complaint or incident goes viral and is picked up by mainstream media
consequence: Loss of customers, partner confidence and management time

title: Short-term liquidity squeeze
cause: Seasonal cash flows, concentrated customer receivables and a facility renewal due
event: Cash falls below operating needs during a downturn or if the facility is not renewed
consequence: Missed payments, distressed borrowing and covenant breach

title: Major transformation project overruns
cause: Optimistic business case, unclear scope and weak project governance
event: The programme exceeds budget and schedule by more than 30%
consequence: Lost benefits, cost overrun and delayed strategic goals

title: Serious injury to staff or public
cause: Inconsistent safety inspections and contractor induction
event: A slip, fall, machinery or vehicle incident causes serious injury
consequence: Harm to people, regulatory investigation, compensation and reputational damage

title: Adverse foreign exchange movements
cause: Material costs and revenues in different currencies without a hedging policy
event: Exchange rates move sharply against the organisation
consequence: Margin erosion and budget overruns

title: Weak speak-up culture
cause: Staff fear blame and managers react defensively to bad news
event: Warning signs are not reported until they become incidents
consequence: Late detection of misconduct, safety issues and control failures

title: Fire in guest or kitchen areas
cause: Kitchen extraction ducts are cleaned irregularly and fire doors are propped open
event: A fire starts in a kitchen and spreads to guest areas
consequence: Injury or loss of life, property damage, closure and prosecution
notes: Duct cleaning overdue at two properties.

title: Guest injury at pool and leisure facilities
cause: Lifeguard cover is not scheduled for peak hours and signage is inconsistent
event: A guest is seriously injured or drowns
consequence: Harm to guests, liability claims and reputational damage

title: Payment card data compromise
cause: Legacy point-of-sale terminals and shared front-desk logins
event: Card data is stolen from the property management or payment systems
consequence: Card scheme fines, forensic costs, notification and loss of guest trust

title: Sharp fall in occupancy
cause: Dependence on a few source markets and online travel agents
event: Demand falls due to a downturn, travel restrictions or a competitor opening
consequence: Revenue shortfall against high fixed costs

title: Food safety incident
cause: Temperature logs are completed retrospectively and allergen training lapsed
event: Guests suffer food poisoning or an allergic reaction
consequence: Harm to guests, closure by authorities and reputational damage

title: Concentration of credit losses in commercial property lending
cause: Rapid growth in commercial real estate loans above internal sector limits
event: Property values fall and several large borrowers default
consequence: Credit losses that erode capital and earnings

title: Anti-money laundering control failure
cause: Transaction monitoring rules have not been tuned since a product launch
event: Suspicious transactions are not detected or reported
consequence: Regulatory enforcement, fines and restrictions on business

title: Interest rate risk in the banking book
cause: Long-dated fixed-rate mortgages funded by short-term deposits
event: Rates rise sharply and deposit costs reprice faster than assets
consequence: Net interest margin compression and economic value loss

title: Mis-selling to vulnerable customers
cause: Sales incentives weighted towards product volume
event: Products are sold that are unsuitable for customers
consequence: Redress, regulatory censure and reputational damage

title: Inventory shrinkage and stock loss
cause: Weak warehouse access controls and manual stock counts
event: Theft and recording errors cause unexplained stock loss
consequence: Margin loss and stock-outs

title: Serious road traffic accident involving fleet
cause: Driver fatigue from route scheduling and inconsistent vehicle maintenance
event: A company vehicle is involved in a fatal or serious collision
consequence: Harm to people, prosecution, claims and fleet downtime

title: Loss of a major retail customer contract
cause: Top three customers represent 48% of revenue
event: A major customer moves to a competitor at contract renewal
consequence: Revenue and margin loss, stranded warehouse capacity

title: Cloud platform outage breaching customer SLAs
cause: Single-region deployment and manual failover runbook
event: The production platform is unavailable for more than four hours
consequence: SLA credits, customer churn and reputational harm

title: Breach of sensitive customer data
cause: Over-privileged engineer access to production data
event: Sensitive records are exfiltrated through compromised credentials
consequence: Notification costs, regulatory fines and customer loss

title: Unreliable or non-compliant AI model outputs
cause: Models deployed without documented validation or bias testing
event: A model produces harmful, biased or incorrect results at scale
consequence: Customer harm, regulatory action and loss of trust

title: Major process safety incident
cause: Deferred maintenance on pressure systems and alarm fatigue in the control room
event: A loss of containment leads to fire or explosion
consequence: Fatalities, environmental damage, asset loss and licence risk

title: Environmental spill
cause: Ageing storage tanks and inadequate bunding
event: Hydrocarbons are released to soil or water
consequence: Remediation costs, fines and community opposition

title: Commodity price volatility
cause: Revenue tied to spot prices with limited hedging
event: Prices fall sharply for a sustained period
consequence: Cash flow shortfall and project deferrals

title: Construction delay and cost overrun on flagship development
cause: Fixed-price contracts with thinly capitalised contractors and ground-condition uncertainty
event: Contractor insolvency or unforeseen ground conditions halt work
consequence: Cost overrun, delayed income and financing pressure

title: Anchor tenant default
cause: Two tenants account for 35% of rental income
event: An anchor tenant enters administration
consequence: Rental income loss and covenant pressure

title: Critical asset failure due to deferred maintenance
cause: Maintenance budget cut by 20% for three years
event: A lift, HVAC or structural element fails in an occupied building
consequence: Injury, closure, emergency repair costs

title: Failure to deliver essential public services
cause: Legacy case management system and high staff vacancy rate
event: Benefits or permits are delayed for thousands of citizens
consequence: Hardship to citizens, political scrutiny and legal challenge

title: Procurement irregularity
cause: Urgent purchases bypass competitive tender
event: Contracts are awarded without proper process or with conflicts of interest
consequence: Legal challenge, audit qualification and loss of public trust

title: Patient safety incident from medication error
cause: High agency staff usage and inconsistent electronic prescribing
event: A patient receives the wrong medication or dose
consequence: Patient harm, claims and regulatory intervention
controls: Pharmacist review; double-checks for high-risk drugs

title: Capacity shortfall during demand surges
cause: Bed occupancy above 95% with limited surge plans
event: Winter demand exceeds capacity
consequence: Treatment delays, patient harm and staff burnout

title: Medical device or clinical system cyber compromise
cause: Unsupported operating systems on connected devices
event: A connected device is compromised and taken offline
consequence: Disruption to care and patient safety risk

title: Falling below Saudization (Nitaqat) requirements
cause: Rapid expansion relying on expatriate hires and higher Saudi staff turnover
event: The localisation ratio falls below the required band for the sector
consequence: Restrictions on visas and permits, penalties and constrained growth

title: Non-compliance with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL)
cause: Guest data collected across booking channels without consent records
event: Personal data is processed or transferred without a lawful basis
consequence: Regulatory penalties, guest complaints and reputational damage
